title: OVERVIEW
text:
This manual is applied to R-30iB Mate/ R-30iB Mate Plus controller (called R-30iB Mate/ R-30iB Mate Plus).

R-30iB Mate/ R-30iB Mate Plus has different controller depending on the required standards.

- NRTL controller: To meet UL/CSA standard
- CE controller: To meet Machinery Directive, Low voltage Directive, EMC Directive to cover the requirement of CE mark

This manual covers these controllers of the R-30iB Mate/ R-30iB Mate Plus.

The difference of NRTL and CE controller from the Basic controller is small as shown in Table 1 (ex. EMC parts, Breakers).

And the specific descriptions of CE and NRTL controller have notifications in this manual.

This manual describes the maintenance and connection of R-30iB Mate/ R-30iB Mate Plus.

- Maintenance Part: Troubleshooting, and the setting, adjustment, and replacement of units
- Connection Part: Connection of R-30iB Mate/ R-30iB Mate Plus to the robot mechanical unit and peripheral devices, and installation of the controller

title: WARNING
text:
Before you enter the robot working area, be sure to turn off the power to the controller or press the EMERGENCY STOP button on the operator's panel or teach pendant. Otherwise, you could injure personnel or damage equipment.

title: COMPONENT FUNCTIONS
text: 2. CONFIGURATION                     MAINTENANCE                                B-83525EN/07

title: Main board
text: The main board contains a microprocessor, its peripheral circuits, memory, and operator's panel control circuit. The main CPU controls servo mechanism positioning.

title: I/O printed circuit board
text: Various types of printed circuit boards are provided for applications including process I/O board. These are connected with FANUC I/O Link.

title: E-stop unit
text: This unit controls the emergency stop system of the robot controller. It also has user interface terminals of safety relevant signals, external on/off signals etc.

title: Power supply unit
text: The power supply unit converts the AC power to various levels of DC power.

title: Backplane printed circuit board
text: The various control printed circuit boards are mounted on the backplane printed circuit board.

title: Teach pendant
text: All operations including robot programming are performed with this unit. The controller status and data are indicated on the liquid-crystal display (LCD) on the pendant.

title: 6-Axis Servo amplifier
text: The servo amplifier controls servomotor, Pulsecoder signal, brake control, overtravel and hand broken.

title: Operator's panel
text: Buttons and LEDs on the operator's panel are used to start the robot and to indicate the robot status.

title: Fan unit, heat exchanger
text: These components cool the inside of the controller.

title: Circuit breaker
text: If the electric system in the controller malfunctions, or if abnormal input power causes high current in the system, the input power is connected to the circuit breaker to protect the equipment.

title: Regenerative resistor
text:
To discharge the counter electromotive force from the servomotor, connect a regenerative resistor to the servo amplifier.
